if: it is difficult to distinguish whether a change is a change in an accounting POLICY or a change in an accounting ESTIMATE
then: the change is treated as a change in an accounting ESTIMATE, with appropriate disclosure
note: A tie-breaker, not a test — AS 5 supplies a default precisely because the distinction is sometimes undecidable. A system must therefore never report high confidence in a POLICY-change classification merely because the estimate reading was ruled out by difficulty; difficulty resolves the other way.
